entities.summary: Elijah E. Myers was an American architect of government buildings in the latter half of the 19th century, and the architect of three state capitols: the Michigan State Capitol, the Texas State Capitol, and the Colorado State Capitol. He also designed buildings in Mexico and Brazil. Myers favored Victorian Gothic and Neo-Classical styles, but he worked in other styles as well.
